ACCUEIL.AUCUNE_AVENTURE:
The Darklords have attacked
the Kai monastery where young prodigies
like you are trained in the art of war.
You are the sole survivor of the battle,
and a vital mission now falls to you:
warn the King of Sommerlund
that the Darklords
have wiped out the country's warrior elite.
The enemies who have sworn your death
will do everything to stop you.

INTRO_CREATION.PARAGRAPHE_1: During the training that made you a Kai Lord, you gained exceptional strength; the two essential elements of this strength are represented by your COMBAT SKILL and your ENDURANCE. Before setting out on your mission, you will need to measure exactly how effective your training has been.
INTRO_CREATION.PARAGRAPHE_HABILITE: By tapping the COMBAT SKILL die, the app rolls a number between 0 and 9 for you. This number is automatically added to 10, and the total is entered directly in your character's COMBAT SKILL slot (if, for example, the app rolls a 4, your COMBAT SKILL score will be 14). Whenever you have to fight, your COMBAT SKILL will be measured against your opponent's. It is therefore in your interest for your COMBAT SKILL total to be as high as possible.
INTRO_CREATION.PARAGRAPHE_ENDURANCE: By tapping the ENDURANCE die, the app rolls a second number between 0 and 9 for you. This number is automatically added to 20, and the total is entered directly in your character's ENDURANCE slot (for example, if the app rolls a 6, your total ENDURANCE score will be 26).
INTRO_CREATION.PARAGRAPHE_MORT: If you are wounded in combat, you will lose ENDURANCE points, and if your ENDURANCE ever falls to zero, you will know that you have been killed and that your adventure is over. During your mission, you will have the chance to recover ENDURANCE points, but your ENDURANCE total may never exceed the score you had at the start of your mission.
INTRO_CREATION.PARAGRAPHE_DISCIPLINES: Over the centuries, the Kai Monks learned to master every technique of the warrior. These techniques are known as the Kai Disciplines and are taught to the Kai Lords. For your part, you have been trained in only five of the techniques described below. It is up to you to choose these five Disciplines yourself. Each Kai Discipline may prove useful to you at some point on your quest, so choose as wisely as you can: in certain circumstances, the skilful use of one of these techniques could save your life.
INTRO_CREATION.PARAGRAPHE_DISCIPLINES_2: If you successfully complete the mission assigned to you in this first book of the Lone Wolf series, you will be entitled to add one further Kai Discipline to those you already possess. When you set out on the new adventure offered by the next volume in the series (entitled Fire on the Water), you will then be able to draw on six Kai Disciplines (the first five being yours for good), as well as any Special Items you decide to keep from your first mission. Know that, from book to book, your experience will grow every time you complete a mission: in this way, you may one day hope to achieve complete mastery of the art and science of the Kai Monks.

INTRO_INVENTAIRE.PARAGRAPHE_1: At the start of your adventure, you are wearing a Kai Lord's tunic and cloak, both green. Aside from that, the equipment you have to ensure your survival is reduced to a minimum. You own an Axe and a Backpack containing one Meal
INTRO_INVENTAIRE.PARAGRAPHE_2: You also carry, attached to your belt, a leather pouch containing Gold Crowns. By tapping the Gold Crowns die, the app rolls a number between 0 and 9 for you. The number you get will represent the number of Crowns (the currency used in these lands) you have at the start of your mission
INTRO_INVENTAIRE.PARAGRAPHE_3: In the smouldering ruins of the destroyed monastery, you found a map that will help you find your way. This map is carefully tucked away in an inner pocket of your tunic.
INTRO_INVENTAIRE.PARAGRAPHE_4: You have also found one of the following items:
INTRO_INVENTAIRE.PARAGRAPHE_5: To find out which item you discovered from the list above, tap the item die:
INTRO_INVENTAIRE.PARAGRAPHE_6: The app will randomly draw one of the items.

INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_1: You now have your equipment; you need to know how it is organised so you can carry it more easily.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_ARMES: You may not carry more than two weapons.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_SAC_A_DOS: Items must always be kept in your Backpack, but space is limited and you may carry no more than eight items in it (Meals included).
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_OBJETS_SPECIAUX: Special Items are not kept in your Backpack. Whenever you have the chance to acquire one of these Special Items, you will be told how it should be carried.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_OR: These are always kept in the pouch attached to your belt. This pouch cannot hold more than fifty Gold Crowns in total.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_NOURRITURE: You carry your food in your Backpack, and each Meal counts as one item.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_2: All the items that may be useful to you, and that you will have the chance to acquire in the course of your adventure, are shown with their initial in a capital letter. Whenever you decide to take one of these items with you, you will need to add it to your inventory. These items will be kept in your Backpack unless you are told it is a Special Item.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_ARMES_2: Weapons help you fight your enemies. If you have chosen the Weaponskill Discipline and you carry the weapon assigned to you, you may add 2 points to your COMBAT SKILL total. If you are forced to fight without a weapon, you must deduct 4 points from your COMBAT SKILL total and fight bare-handed. If you find a weapon during your adventure, you may keep and use it, but remember that you may never own more than two weapons at once.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_SAC_A_DOS_2: During your quest, you will discover various items that may prove useful and that you may wish to keep (remember that you can only carry eight items in your Backpack). You may, at any time, swap one of these items for another or simply discard it, but you are forbidden to do so while engaged in combat.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_OBJETS_SPECIAUX_2: Each of these items has very particular properties. Sometimes these properties will be described to you the moment you find the item; at other times, you will have to wait for them to be revealed during your adventure. To help you find your way, you have a map you saved from the ashes of the destroyed monastery.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_OR_2: The currency used in the kingdom is the Crown, a small gold coin. During your adventure, you may use these Crowns to pay for travel or food, and also, if need be, to bribe certain unscrupulous characters. Many of the creatures you will encounter carry Gold Crowns. Whenever you kill one of these creatures, you may take its gold and keep it in your pouch.
INTRO_EQUIPEMENT.PARAGRAPHE_NOURRITURE_2: Throughout your quest, you will need to eat at regular intervals. If you have no food left when you are required to eat a Meal, you will lose 3 ENDURANCE points. But if you have chosen the Hunting Discipline among your Kai Disciplines, you will not need to cross a Meal off your equipment list whenever you must eat. The Healing Potion restores 4 ENDURANCE points when you drink it after a combat, but you only have a single dose. If, during your adventure, you find other potions, their effects will be explained to you in due course. All Healing Potions must be kept in your Backpack.

INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_1: You are now about to cross paths with enemies determined to bar your way. The combat ahead of you is not fought here with dice rolled on a sheet of paper: it is the app that rolls for you, number after number, always comparing your COMBAT SKILL to your opponent's. The greater the gap in your favour, the more your blows land, and the more theirs are wasted.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_ATTAQUER: You strike a direct blow. If the enemy survives, it strikes back at once in the same round: so you too take the brunt of your own offensive. This is the simplest action, but also the riskiest.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_DEFENDRE: You raise your guard instead of striking. Part of the damage from the enemy's counter-attack is absorbed (from 25% up to a total block, depending on your luck that round), and you sometimes seize an opening that will boost your COMBAT SKILL for your next ATTACK. Defending never harms the enemy: it's a round to catch your breath, not to finish the fight.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_OBJET: You use an item from your Backpack (a Potion, for example) in the heat of battle. Careful: this does not shield you in any way — the enemy also takes advantage of this round to land its own blow.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_FUITE: You break off combat and vanish without a backward glance. This option is not always available: some opponents or circumstances force you to fight a minimum number of rounds before you can try your luck.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_RESOLUTION_1: At every round, the app calculates the gap between your COMBAT SKILL (the base value, boosted where applicable by your Kai Disciplines and equipment) and your opponent's. This gap determines how much luck favours you: the greater it is in your favour, the more the randomly drawn numbers will work for you.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_RESOLUTION_2: If your ATTACK finishes off the enemy, it collapses before it can strike back: you take no damage that round. In every other case, COMBAT SKILL and ENDURANCE clash on both sides at once, every round.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_COUP_FATAL: On rare occasions, a blow can prove fatal outright, regardless of how much ENDURANCE the victim has left. This brutal outcome can strike your enemies just as easily as yourself: keep this in mind before rushing headlong into a fight.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_DISCIPLINES: Three of the five Kai Disciplines you chose when creating your character can directly affect the outcome of a combat.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_MAITRISE_ARMES: If you have mastered this Discipline and you carry the weapon assigned to you, you add 2 points to your COMBAT SKILL for the whole fight. Conversely, fighting bare-handed, with no weapon at all, costs you 4.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_PUISSANCE_PSYCHIQUE: This Discipline adds 2 points to your COMBAT SKILL against most creatures. Some tougher enemies are immune to it, however: in that case, the bonus does not apply.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_BOUCLIER_PSYCHIQUE: Some enemies use psychic powers of their own to weaken your COMBAT SKILL during combat. This Discipline protects you from it entirely.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_PLUSIEURS_ENNEMIS: Some fights pit you against several opponents at once. You then fight them one after another: as soon as the first falls, the next immediately takes its place, with no rest in between, until none remain standing.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_MORT_1: If your ENDURANCE falls to zero during a combat, you are defeated. This is a different outcome from a death occurring elsewhere in a chapter: here, for 1 Premium Coin, you do not revive on the spot — you return to the previous chapter, as if you had turned back just before the fatal encounter.
INTRO_COMBAT.PARAGRAPHE_MORT_2: Without a Premium Coin, your adventure ends here. Fight wisely, then: sometimes it is better to defend or flee than to throw yourself headlong into a fight you cannot win.

VICTOIRE.BRAVO: Well done, {{nom}}. You have braved a thousand perils to bring the King word of the fall of the Kai monastery, and your courage has just saved the kingdom of Sommerlund from certain defeat.
VICTOIRE.PARAGRAPHE_TOME_2: The Darklords have invaded the Kingdom of Sommerlund. Holmgard, the capital, is besieged by a powerful enemy army. Only the Sommerswerd can free the city. It is you, Lone Wolf, who must travel to the Kingdom of Durenor to fetch it... A long and perilous journey awaits you, by sea and by land.
